title: Setback to an adjoining laneway or right-of-way that is not the primary street
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a, adjoining laneway or right-of-way, where it is not the primary street to the dwelling: R10 and R12.5 As per Secondary Street setbacks; R15-25 to R50-60 0.5m.

replaces.note: R10-R25 ROW treated as a secondary street: R15-R25 1.5 m -> 0.5 m; R10-R12.5 unchanged (as per secondary street)
ROW not the primary street 0.5 m (R30-R60)

verified.note: 'As per Secondary Street setbacks' is one cell spanning R10 and R12.5 across both laneway rows; 0.5m spans R15-25 to R50-60 (p29). Table 4A (p7) prints the same merged cells.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.1#laneway. R10-R12.5 'as per secondary street setbacks' (3 m, 2 m), R15-R60 0.5 m (p29, p7; C4P1-077). Communal streets are not listed (C3.3.1#communal-street).
